attributes.text: Enable Accessibility Service as an extra lock and unlock signal
attributes.originalText: Enable Accessibility Service as an extra lock and unlock signal

attributes.text: Notices the lock screen appearing and going away, as an extra signal next to the screen on/off events, and cancels lock actions an unlock made unnecessary. Does not read screen content.
